# service-backup Agent Context

> Start from the product contract and the local workflow, then the tests that
> judge them. There is no separate design tree: the `.rs` file is the authoring
> surface, and each module's `//!` block carries the rules it owns.

## Contract

- [README.md](README.md): product promises. `## Capabilities` is the contract.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): local edit and verification rules.

## Behaviour

- [tests/it/](tests/it/main.rs): the externally observable cases, as modules
  of one test binary: `cargo test -p service-backup --all-features --test it`.
  - [projected_admin_transport.rs](tests/it/projected_admin_transport.rs) and
    [admin_request_golden.rs](tests/it/admin_request_golden.rs): the admin
    snapshot transport; built only with the `http-client` feature.
  - [wire_golden.rs](tests/it/wire_golden.rs) and
    [schema_golden.rs](tests/it/schema_golden.rs): the CRD JSON, its
    `schemars` schema, the rendered topic and the destination and policy error
    text, pinned byte for byte.
- Rules observable only inside the implementation stay as colocated unit tests
  under their `src/**` owner: `cargo test -p service-backup --lib`.

## Commands

- Test: `cargo test -p service-backup`.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): this file. Hand-maintained. It was generated by the `aw`
  CLI until that binary was deleted; nothing regenerates it now, so an edit here
  is the whole of the change.
